summary: Normalizes XYZ positions or any selected attribute into 0-1 ranges, with support for cartesian, polar, cylindrical, bias, lookup-curve, exponent, and output re-range workflows.

key_params.name: inputattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute or components to normalize

key_concepts: Rescales selected attribute components into a normalized 0-1 range and writes them to existing or new attributes.
Supports Cartesian, polar, and cylindrical normalization modes for position-derived coordinate attributes.
Bias, lookup curve, exponent, and to-low/to-high controls shape normalized values after the initial 0-1 mapping.
Aspect correction and error replacement help keep normalization stable when bounds, NaN, or infinite values are present.
common_gotchas: Normalize can process arbitrary components, so swizzled scopes like P(1) P(0) change the coordinate interpretation.
Polar and cylindrical normalization derive ranges from geometry, such as farthest radius.
Use Projection POP when the task is true coordinate-system conversion rather than normalization plus shaping.
